limitations: Public UNESCO pages are used only to inspire broad themes, not to assert real programme activities.
No live UNESCO dataset, official allocation or real field record is copied into this file.
Amounts are illustrative demo values, not financial actuals or approved budgets.
Replace or remove this dataset before any production use.

overhaulNotes: Activity current status is an explicit current-state field; do not infer it from any historical log.
progress_pct and due_date are fictional demonstration fields for interface testing.
risk_level is a simple demo classification and must be validated against a real risk register before production use.
